notes: A malformed export in which two nodes name each other as parent.

Apple follows `parent` links with no cycle check: the importer never returns and its node list grows without bound (confirmed with a watchdog: no result after 400 ms, while the same data without the cycle returns in about 20 ms). The web app stops at the first node it has already visited.
